entry.title: Resolution 545 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS RULE NO. 2 OF THE RULES OF PROCEDURE AND ORGANIZATION OF THE COUNCIL OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I, RELATING TO EXCUSED AND UNEXCUSED ABSENCES

Requires a member of the Council to notify the Council Chair whenever that member is unable to attend a Council meeting; requires the Council Chair to determine and announce whether the absence is excused or unexcused.

Status: — → Adopted
